description_en: Queries whether an IoT card is a directional card
description_zh: 查询物联网卡是否为定向卡
name: VerifyIotCard

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card, or on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台的卡管理页面，查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: The call was successful.

Other codes: The call failed. For more information about error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：调用成功。

其他：调用失败。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the card is a directional card.

true: The card is a directional card.

false: The card is not a directional card
Data.description_zh:
是否为定向卡。

true：是定向卡。

false：不是定向卡

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current location
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
